title: Inference gateway P1: pass the Open Responses acceptance suite and an OpenAI SDK Chat Completions run
body:
Spec: [`docs/inference/gateway.md`](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/inference/gateway.md), section 3.

Prove the API against the standards:

- Run the Open Responses acceptance suite (https://www.openresponses.org/compliance; 10 HTTP tests now, 7 WebSocket tests in P2) against staging before each release and against production, and record the run.
- A Chat Completions conformance run with the official OpenAI SDKs (Python and JavaScript), streaming and tools included, checking each row of section 3's mapping table.

Blocked by: #11065.
